node: Assessment, credentialing, identity verification, and remote proctoring infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the trusted-verification node beyond obvious online education providers. The best underfollowed mappings are healthcare workforce credentialing and competency infrastructure, employer identity/education verification, and high-stakes digital language testing. Pearson remains the reference anchor for professional test delivery; HealthStream and First Advantage are more obscure second-order beneficiaries because they are classified as healthcare software and employment screening rather than education. Duolingo is a higher-attention name, but its English Test is a relatively small, institution-dependent assessment business that directly tests the AI-era proctoring and credential-validity bottleneck.
